p0.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi quick change float handle is the Easy Lock handle that the Sweepex sponges clip onto. Buy one handle and you can run a plain sponge for smooth tiles, a cut sponge for textured tiles and a cellulose sponge for epoxy, swapping between them in seconds, and only ever replace the sponge when it wears.

Fits

  • Raimondi 13 x 30 cm Sweepex sponges (plain, cut, carved or cellulose) with the Easy Lock fitting
  • Raimondi 17 x 34 cm Sweepex sponges (plain, cut, carved or cellulose) with the Easy Lock fitting

Specifications

  • Handle: 24 x 10 cm
  • Easy Lock quick change system
  • Model: 306IR20DN
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Press the sponge on until it clicks, and check it is locked before you start washing.
  • Rinse the lock clean at the end of the day. Dried grout in the fitting makes the next sponge hard to seat.
  • The 13 x 42 cm pole sponges use a different plate for the aluminium handle.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi 13 x 30 cm Sweepex sponge float is the standard hand float for washing grout off walls and floors. Sweepex is Raimondi's very high absorption sponge, so it lifts more grout water per pass than an ordinary sponge, and the 13 x 30 size fits the rollers on the Skipper, Pulirapid and Smart wash buckets. The sponge clips off the Easy Lock handle for replacement.

Use it for

  • Washing cement grout residue off wall and floor tiles
  • Working with the Skipper, Pulirapid and Smart wash buckets

Features

  • Very high absorption Sweepex sponge
  • Quick change Easy Lock interchangeable sponge
  • Ergonomic handle

Specifications

  • Sponge: 13 x 30 x 3 cm
  • Model: 217 SWE
  • Made in Italy

Fits

  • The float supplied with the Skipper, Pulirapid and Smart buckets; takes the 13 x 30 cm Sweepex spare sponges (plain Art. 217 RICSWE, with cuts, carved or cellulose)

Good to know

  • Draw the float through the bucket rollers to wring it rather than squeezing by hand.
  • For textured tiles use the cut or carved sponge version.

p2.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi 13 x 30 cm Sweepex float with cut sponge is the hand float for washing grout off textured tiles. The cuts let the sponge flex down into structured surfaces and wide joints that a flat sponge skates over, while the very high absorption Sweepex lifts the grout water away. It fits the rollers on the Skipper, Pulirapid and Smart buckets and the sponge clips off the Easy Lock handle for replacement.

Use it for

  • Washing cement grout residue off textured, stone look and timber look tiles
  • Walls and floors with wide joints

Features

  • Very high absorption Sweepex sponge with cuts
  • Quick change Easy Lock interchangeable sponge
  • Ergonomic handle

Specifications

  • Sponge: 13 x 30 x 3 cm
  • Model: 217 SWET
  • Made in Italy

Fits

  • The float supplied with the Skipper, Pulirapid and Smart buckets; takes the 13 x 30 cm Sweepex spare sponges (with cuts Art. 217 RICSWGT, plain, carved or cellulose)

Good to know

  • For smooth tiles the plain Sweepex float holds a little more water.
  • Draw the float through the bucket rollers to wring it.

p3.descriptionHtml:
Replacement Sweepex sponge for the Raimondi 13 x 30 cm quick change float. The sponge is the wearing part of the float, and a fresh one brings back the very high absorption that lets you wash grout off a wall or floor in fewer passes. It clips onto the Easy Lock handle in seconds, no tools.

Fits

  • Raimondi quick change float handle (Easy Lock) and the 13 x 30 cm floats supplied with the Skipper, Pulirapid and Smart buckets

Specifications

  • Size: 13 x 30 x 3 cm
  • Sweepex sponge, very high absorption
  • Quick change Easy Lock fitting
  • Model: 217 RICSWE
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Change the sponge when it goes hard, tears at the corners or stops holding water.
  • The same size is made with cuts and carved for textured tiles, and in cellulose (Art. 217 RICCEL) for epoxy grout.
  • Rinse the sponge clean and let it dry between jobs so grout does not set in it.

p4.descriptionHtml:
Replacement Sweepex sponge with cuts for the Raimondi 13 x 30 cm quick change float. The cuts let the sponge flex down into textured tiles and wide joints, so it washes grout off structured surfaces that a flat sponge glides over, and the Sweepex material keeps the very high absorption. It clips onto the Easy Lock handle in seconds.

Fits

  • Raimondi quick change float handle (Easy Lock) and the 13 x 30 cm floats supplied with the Skipper, Pulirapid and Smart buckets

Specifications

  • Size: 13 x 30 x 3 cm
  • Sweepex sponge with cuts, very high absorption
  • Quick change Easy Lock fitting
  • Model: 217 RICSWGT
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Use it on stone look, timber look and other textured porcelain. For smooth tiles the plain sponge holds a little more water.
  • For epoxy grout Raimondi makes a cellulose sponge in the same size.
  • Rinse clean and dry between jobs so grout does not set in the cuts.

p5.descriptionHtml:
Carved replacement Sweepex sponge for the Raimondi 13 x 30 cm quick change float. The carved face is Raimondi's deepest sponge profile, cut to follow heavily structured and relief tiles so it reaches the grout in the low spots rather than only wiping the high points. The Sweepex material keeps the very high absorption, and it clips onto the Easy Lock handle in seconds.

Fits

  • Raimondi quick change float handle (Easy Lock) and the 13 x 30 cm floats supplied with the Skipper, Pulirapid and Smart buckets

Specifications

  • Size: 13 x 30 x 3 cm
  • Carved Sweepex sponge, very high absorption
  • Quick change Easy Lock fitting
  • Model: 217 RICSWESCO
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Raimondi makes the same size in plain Sweepex for smooth tiles, Sweepex with cuts for lightly textured tiles, and cellulose for epoxy grout.
  • Wring the carved sponge well through the bucket rollers. It holds water in the grooves.
  • Rinse clean and dry between jobs.

p6.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 120 x 250 mm scouring pads for the Velcro float handle, in three grades. They are the pads for shifting grout haze and dried residue that a sponge will not move: white is fine for a light polish on glazed tile, green is medium for everyday haze, and black is coarse for stubborn cement film and emulsifying epoxy. The pad presses onto the handle's Velcro face and peels off when you change grade.

Use it for

  • Removing cement grout haze and dried residue from tiles
  • Emulsifying epoxy grout residue before the final wash
  • Scrubbing textured tiles where a sponge skates over the surface

Fits

  • Raimondi scouring pad kit handle (120 x 250 mm Velcro)

Specifications

  • Size: 120 x 250 x 20 mm
  • Grades: fine (white, low abrasion), medium (green), coarse (black)
  • Raimondi replacement abrasive pads, Art. 227 series

Good to know

  • Start with the finest pad that does the job and test the coarse pad on a spare tile. It can dull a polished or soft glaze.
  • Rinse the pad often so loosened grout does not scratch the tile.

p7.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi scouring pad set is the starter kit for cleaning grout haze off tiles: a Velcro faced float handle plus one pad in each of the three grades. Use the fine pad for a light polish, the medium pad for everyday cement haze and the coarse pad for stubborn film and emulsifying epoxy, swapping pads on the Velcro face as the job changes.

Use it for

  • Removing cement grout haze and dried residue from floor and wall tiles
  • Breaking down epoxy grout residue before the final sponge wash
  • Scrubbing textured tiles

What's in the box

  • Velcro float handle
  • 1 x coarse, 1 x medium and 1 x fine 120 x 250 mm scouring pad

Specifications

  • Pad size: 120 x 250 x 20 mm
  • Velcro (hook and loop) handle for quick pad changes

Good to know

  • Spare 120 x 250 mm pads are sold separately by grade, so the handle lasts for years.
  • Test the coarse pad on a spare tile before using it on a polished or soft glaze.
  • Rinse the pad often so loosened grout does not scratch the tile.
